polityNote: Republic of Iceland. First level = the eight statistical regions (landsvæði) of Statistics Iceland, which are groupings of municipalities and not administrative governments. Earlier first-level layouts (amt until 1904, then 23 sýslur + kaupstaðir, constituencies 1959-2003) are not unions of NE atoms and are not covered; scope starts at the earliest date found documenting the eight regions (ISO 3166-2, 1998-12-15).
